news.text: AN ATTACKING #JUVE"THE LEVEL HAS BEEN RAISED"Tour and mercato: #Spalletti is confident2-0 against #Palermo (#Yildiz and #Milik) in the last friend match in Perth. The coach: "Up front there is competition now. #DouglasLuiz may stay. The directors told me that the team will be completed soon". Agreement with #Lucumí: now a relaunch with #Bologna. #Suzuki to #PSG: #Juve is waiting for him on loan.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🥅 "As soon as #PSG officially closes the purchase of Zion #Suzuki, they will give #Juventus a maximum of 48 hours to deliver a response on whether they will receive the Japanese goalkeeper.#Juve had direct conversations with the player in recent days."[@MomblanOfficial on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]

.@Inter, for the winger position, the target is #Spence. If #LuisHenrique leaves, an alternative with more offensive characteristics is sought: not only Nico #González and #Diaby but also Malick #Fofana. @GuarroPas[Di Marzio]

🇵🇱🆙 #Milik has given comforting signals. His entourage is expected at la Continassa for a talk with management. For #Spalletti, he can become very useful due to his experience and characteristics. The Pole is now doing well mentally and has rediscovered a good potential level. He could still have a mercato, but with him in the squad, the arrival of #Zirkzee would also make more sense.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

✅ Juan #Cabal is not the only one on #Bologna's list to reinforce the defense. The felsinei are showing interest in Juan #Rodriguez from #Cagliari (valuation around 10mln) and Fedde #Leysen from #UnionStGilloise.[Mirko Di Natale]

GJustjuve .@juventusfc, for the goal, #Suzuki and #Vicario remain in the race: the club wants to close the deal this week. [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71040👀 The goalkeeper situation at #Juventus remains a hot topic.For the bianconeri, the names of #Suzuki and #Vicario are always still alive.As for the Japanese, the conversations have not yet deepened, with #PSG finalizing the deal with #Parma.#Juve will only understand afterward the conditions for a loan of the goalkeeper by the French club.On #Vicario, there has been an initial indirect approach with #Tottenham.In fact, la Vecchia Signora is waiting for an opening from the English toward a loan.#Juventus expects to define the goalke

GJustjuve .@juventusfc, #Lucumí remains the target in defense: agreement with the player locked down, negotiations are underway with #Bologna [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71039🇨🇴🆙 #Lucumí remains the main objective for the defense: he has always maintained his position, determined to wait for the agreement between the clubs. In these hours, #Juventus has once again locked down the economic agreement with the player and will continue to negotiate with #Bologna to find the definitive economic agreement. The request is €25M, while the bianconeri aim to spend less. However, #Cabal can also be included in the deal.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]
.@juventusfc, for the goal, #Suzuki and #Vicario remain in the race: the club wants to close the deal this week.[Di Marzio]
.@juventusfc, #Lucumí remains the target in defense: agreement with the player locked down, negotiations are underway with #Bologna[Di Marzio]

🆙❗️"The two most imminent things today for #Juventus are the goalkeeper and the defender. The documents between #PSG and #Parma for #Suzuki are ready, then we will see the bianconeri's response to a potential simple loan. The #Lucumí affair will have a follow-up and we will have to put a definitive end point to it. #Kessié is waiting, as is #Goretzka. We will put all of this into a clean draft soon, because if today was frantic, tomorrow will be even more so."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹😅 "#Frattesi waited for a long time and perhaps still continues to wait for a signal from #Juventus, which, however, has not arrived. Now he has opened to #Lazio and would willingly go there, waiting to put all the puzzle pieces in place."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
.@OfficialSSLazio and @Inter are at work for #Frattesi: they are negotiating a loan with a conditional obligation to buy and a resale percentage for the nerazzurri @GuarroPas @SkySport[Di Marzio]

✅‼️#Juventus will present, during the course of this week, a new offer to #Bologna for Jhon #Lucumí, closing in on the requested 20/22mln (including bonuses). With the defender, who has placed all other requests on standby, there is an agreement at 2.5mln for four years (until 2030).[Mirko Di Natale]

#Juventus has never been this close to #Lucumí. The bianconeri have further intensified contacts with #Bologna and aim to close the deal before #Bologna's departure for Brighton. The agreement with the Colombian defender is full.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

On the #Juventus front, they ask for calmness on the possible loan of #Suzuki from #PSG: there are still several things to evaluate. On the other hand, the #Trubin track is flatly denied and downplayed. This is what is leaking from the high levels of the bianconero club. #calciomercato[Alessio Lento]

GJustjuve 🚨⚫️⚪️ Juventus have reached full agreement on personal terms with Jhon Lucumí and his agents. Lucumí only wants Juventus as always reported; negotiations are re-starting this week between clubs with Bologna. Deal underway. [Fabrizio Romano] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71031🇨🇴🔛 "#Juventus has a full agreement with #Lucumí on the contract: he has waited and continues to wait for the bianconeri. Now it is up to the two clubs to find an agreement. There is full agreement with the agents and an ok on the salary. Starting from tomorrow, the Piedmontese will be back in contact with #Bologna for a new offer and we will see if the numbers match, the only true obstacle."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube

🚨⚫️⚪️ Juventus have reached full agreement on personal terms with Jhon Lucumí and his agents.Lucumí only wants Juventus as always reported; negotiations are re-starting this week between clubs with Bologna.Deal underway.[Fabrizio Romano]
#Juve-#Bologna, another round in sight for #Lucumi: the bianconeri continue to work to unblock the deal and a new raised offer is expected this week 💰⚪️⚫️[Romeo Agresti]

👀 "At this moment, the players who are stipulated to probably stay in the #Juventus midfield are: #Locatelli, #Thuram (unless an important offer arrives), #DouglasLuiz, and #McKennie.For another reinforcement to join (#Kessié being the closest) at least two of the outcasts must leave: #Miretti, #Koopmeiners and #Arthur."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🇨🇴🔜 "Between tomorrow and after tomorrow, #Juventus will return to the push with #Bologna and will increase the offer for #Lucumí: from €17M it will reach €20M + #Cabal on loan with an option to buy. The rossoblù are very tempted and the full-back has given his availability, just as the defender has given his to the bianconeri for a five-year contract at €2.5M. It could be the Ferragosto signing."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
